jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. jobs.occupation: Sushi chef (m/f/d) Full-Time - Steinheim an der Murr (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description: ROLLING SINCE '97It all started in 1997 – with the very first kaiten sushi restaurant in Frankfurt. Back then, we brought the legendary sushi conveyor belt to Germany, bringing a real pioneering spirit to the restaurant scene. Our roots? High-quality ingredients, craftsmanship, and fine cuisine made with love.Today, Sushi Circle is established in Germany and Eastern Europe: two restaurants and over 300 sushi islands in supermarkets. And the best part? Our sushi is rolled fresh every day, right on site – with a lot of love and over 25 years of experience. For you, that means the best quality, great taste, and always fresh.YOUR MISSION:- Preparing fresh, unusual sushi creations- Carefully processing high-quality raw ingredients such as fresh fish and vegetables- Receiving and properly storing our fresh ingredients- Advising our customers on questions about our products- Complying with all quality and hygiene standardsYOUR SKILLS:- Flexibility, team spirit, and a sense of responsibility- Basic knowledge of German or English- Enjoyment of working with fresh food and attention to detail- Well-groomed, friendly appearance and customer-oriented thinkingMORE FOR YOU:- Cool training by our own trainers- A job in a constantly growing company- Performance-based compensation with a bonus program- Exciting career opportunities- Further education opportunities and trainingDeine Aufgaben:Wir erwarten:Wir bieten:

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant / Manager - Risk Management (Liquidity and Market Price Risk) (f|m|x) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description: As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients inthe banking sector and financial services industry on complex topicsrelated to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their currentsituation, identify new requirements early on and, together with yourteam, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the wayto implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continueddevelopment of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enablingwell‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matterresponsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape thecontent development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: Yousupport and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financialservices providers in their liquidity and market price riskmanagement, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and thedesign of client-specific solutions through to implementation. Youdevelop integrated management approaches for liquidity and marketprice risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitativemodeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interestrate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you designmethodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) anddevelop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well asnet interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you alsoensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, forinstance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of yourteam and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientationand professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – bothwithin the team and with our clients. You also mentor juniorcolleagues, developing both their professional capabilities andpersonal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. Youactively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consultingportfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage andderive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support thedevelopment of new offerings and the acquisition of new clientmandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented bycertifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years ofprofessional experience in consulting or the financial industry.Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects inliquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, andinitial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinatingteam members) is also part of your profile. You have a solidunderstanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well asthe ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analyticaland quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programmingskills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar withrelevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBAGuidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is aplus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented mannerand communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of workingcomes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility withina team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (atleast B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybridYour benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road withzeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accidentinsurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additionaltravel health insurance and you can also take out a company pensionplan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remotework is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are onthe train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life ischanging—and we would like to accompany you through the differentphases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, lifesituation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” appliesfor all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanentemployees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop yourpart-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career DevelopmentCounselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it asrequired. Define your working time model according to your personalneeds and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. Asa contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-freeweekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction oftravel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period oftime.
